rationale: With only 17 minutes to close, the stock opened at $49.98 and has collapsed to $41.83, sitting at just 5.5% of today's range near the session low — a brutal intraday reversal of roughly 16%. The risk/reward of entering into this late-day chop after a massive gap-and-dump is unfavorable regardless of direction.
